props.animation_script:
// @desc Spear: caster lunges/thrusts toward target and snaps back (melee, oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

reachFrac: 0.62, // how far toward the target the thrust travels

outMs: 150, // lunge-out (fast)

holdMs: 70, // pause at extension

backMs: 200, // recover

sparkSize: 130, // impact spark px

sparkColor: "#ffffff",

shakeMs: 160,

shakeIntensity: 5,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const target = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster || !target) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95000 });

const clone = oni.cloneToken(caster, { parent: layer });

if (!clone) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

oni.hideToken(caster);

const home = { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y };

const dx = target.center.x - home.x, dy = target.center.y - home.y;

const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;

const ux = dx / dist, uy = dy / dist;

const reach = Math.max(0, Math.min(dist * cfg.reachFrac, dist - caster.w * 0.4));

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.outMs, ease: oni.EASE.inQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => clone.position.set(home.x + ux * reach * v, home.y + uy * reach * v),

});

const spark = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.sparkColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 128 }));

spark.anchor.set(0.5);

spark.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

spark.position.set(home.x + ux * reach, home.y + uy * reach);

layer.addChild(spark);

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: cfg.shakeIntensity });

oni.fireDone();

oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: 240, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => { spark.width = spark.height = cfg.sparkSize * (0.4 + v); spark.alpha = 1 - v; } });

await oni.wait(cfg.holdMs);

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.backMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => clone.position.set(home.x + ux * reach * (1 - v), home.y + uy * reach * (1 - v)),

});

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/ozealot-spear",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.outMs + 4000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Jump: squash + leap off the top of the screen; token goes invisible with a

// ground shadow, held until Flying is removed (Stoneshatter Dive / lose Flying). (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

squashMs: 130, squashAmt: 0.34,

leapMs: 360, riseFrac: 1.45, stretch: 0.28,

shadowScaleX: 1.0, shadowScaleY: 0.52, shadowAlpha: 0.45,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

const tdoc = casterUuid ? await fromUuid(casterUuid) : null;

const token = tdoc?.object ?? null;

// Register the Flying-removal come-down hook ONCE (GM-only; this outer runs on GM).

if (globalThis.__ozealotAirborneHook == null) {

globalThis.__ozealotAirborneHook = Hooks.on("deleteActiveEffect", async (effect) => {

try {

if (effect?.name !== "Flying") return;

if (globalThis.__ozealotDiving) return; // Dive owns its own visual restore

const actor = effect.parent;

for (const t of (canvas.tokens?.placeables ?? [])) {

const flag = t.document.getFlag("world", "ozealotAirborne");

if (!flag) continue;

if (t.actor !== actor && t.document.actorId !== actor?.id) continue;

await t.document.update({ alpha: 1 });

try {

const sc = game.scenes.get(flag.sceneId) ?? canvas.scene;

if (flag.drawingId && sc) await sc.deleteEmbeddedDocuments("Drawing", [flag.drawingId]);

} catch (e) {}

await t.document.unsetFlag("world", "ozealotAirborne");

}

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ozealot] come-down failed", e); }

});

}

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95000 });

const clone = oni.cloneToken(caster, { parent: layer });

if (!clone) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

oni.hideToken(caster);

const home = { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y };

const baseSX = clone.scale.x, baseSY = clone.scale.y;

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.squashMs, ease: oni.EASE.outQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => {

clone.scale.y = baseSY * (1 - cfg.squashAmt * v);

clone.scale.x = baseSX * (1 + cfg.squashAmt * 0.6 * v);

},

});

const s = oni.screen();

const rise = s.hPx(cfg.riseFrac);

oni.fireDone();

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.leapMs, ease: oni.EASE.inCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => {

clone.position.set(home.x, home.y - rise * v);

clone.scale.y = baseSY * (1 - cfg.squashAmt + (cfg.stretch + cfg.squashAmt) * v);

clone.scale.x = baseSX * (1 - cfg.stretch * 0.4 * v);

clone.alpha = 1 - Math.max(0, v - 0.5) / 0.5;

},

});

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/ozealot-jump",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.squashMs + CFG.leapMs + 4000);

// Persistent airborne state (GM): shadow drawing + invisible token + flag.

if (token && tdoc) {

try {

const shadowW = token.w * CFG.shadowScaleX, shadowH = token.h * CFG.shadowScaleY;

const created = await canvas.scene.createEmbeddedDocuments("Drawing", [{

author: game.user.id,

x: token.center.x - shadowW / 2,

y: token.center.y - shadowH / 2,

shape: { type: "e", width: shadowW, height: shadowH },

fillType: 1, fillColor: "#000000", fillAlpha: CFG.shadowAlpha,

strokeWidth: 0, strokeAlpha: 0, hidden: false, locked: false,

}]);

const drawingId = created?.[0]?.id ?? null;

await tdoc.update({ alpha: 0 });

await tdoc.setFlag("world", "ozealotAirborne", { drawingId, sceneId: canvas.scene.id });

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ozealot] jump state failed", e); }

}

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Stoneshatter Dive: plunge from above onto the target, impact (webm + earth sfx +

// screenshake), then arc back to home and restore the token. (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

startFrac: 1.35, // clone start height above target (screen-height fractions)

diveMs: 340, // plunge (slow -> slam via inCubic)

impactHoldMs: 120,

returnMs: 320,

hopFrac: 0.20, // arc height on the way home

impactUrl: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/Impact_02_Regular_Blue_400x400.webm",

impactScale: 2.1, // impact webm size = target width * this

impactSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Earth5.ogg",

volume: 0.85,

shakeMs: 430, shakeIntensity: 9,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const returnHook = "oni:return:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

const tdoc = casterUuid ? await fromUuid(casterUuid) : null;

// Suppress the Flying-removal come-down hook while WE own the visual restore.

globalThis.__ozealotDiving = true;

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const target = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster || !target) { oni.fireDone(); Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.returnHook); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 96000 });

oni.hideToken(caster);

const clone = oni.cloneToken(caster, { parent: layer });

if (!clone) { oni.fireDone(); Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.returnHook); return; }

const s = oni.screen();

const rise = s.hPx(cfg.startFrac);

const home = { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y };

const tgt = { x: target.center.x, y: target.center.y };

clone.alpha = 1;

clone.position.set(tgt.x, tgt.y - rise);

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.diveMs, ease: oni.EASE.inCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => clone.position.set(tgt.x, (tgt.y - rise) + rise * v),

});

const impact = oni.webmSprite(cfg.impactUrl, { parent: layer });

impact.sprite.position.set(tgt.x, tgt.y);

impact.sprite.width = impact.sprite.height = target.w * cfg.impactScale;

oni.sfx(cfg.impactSfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: cfg.shakeIntensity });

oni.fireDone();

await oni.wait(cfg.impactHoldMs);

const hop = s.hPx(cfg.hopFrac);

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.returnMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => clone.position.set(

tgt.x + (home.x - tgt.x) * v,

tgt.y + (home.y - tgt.y) * v - Math.sin(Math.PI * v) * hop

),

});

Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.returnHook);

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/ozealot-dive",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, returnHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.diveMs + 4000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

// Wait for the clone to land back home, then do OUR come-down (restore token,

// remove the shadow, clear the airborne flag). Guarded so the Flying-removal

// hook (which fires when Dive's on_activate removes Flying) does not double it.

await onceHook(returnHook, CFG.impactHoldMs + CFG.returnMs + 4000);

if (tdoc) {

try {

const flag = tdoc.getFlag("world", "ozealotAirborne");

await tdoc.update({ alpha: 1 });

if (flag) {

try {

const sc = game.scenes.get(flag.sceneId) ?? canvas.scene;

if (flag.drawingId && sc) await sc.deleteEmbeddedDocuments("Drawing", [flag.drawingId]);

} catch (e) {}

await tdoc.unsetFlag("world", "ozealotAirborne");

}

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ozealot] dive come-down failed", e); }

}

globalThis.__ozealotDiving = false;

})();
